t: This powerful module is used to connect inventories to a $(l:logistics/overview)Logistics System/$, effectively allowing controlled item and fluid transfer via pressure tubes.$(p)The inventory or fluid tank that the module points at must be fitted with a $(l:logistics/frames)Logistics Frame/$.$(p)The Logistics Module does not accept an $(l:tubes/module_expansion_card)Module Expansion Card/$.
这个强大的模块用于将容器连接到$(l:logistics/overview)物流系统/$，从而通过压力管道实现受控的物品与流体传输。$(p)该模块所指向的容器或流体储罐必须安装一个$(l:logistics/frames)物流框架/$。$(p)物流管道模块不能安装$(l:tubes/module_expansion_card)模块拓展卡/$。
Two Logistics Modules connecting chests with $(l:logistics/frames#passive_provider)Passive Provider/$ and $(l:logistics/frames#requester)Requester/$ Frames.
两个物流管道模块使用$(l:logistics/frames#passive_provider)被动供应/$和$(l:logistics/frames#requester)请求者/$框架连接箱子。

A network of Logistics Modules is defined by all the modules connected to each other by $(l:tubes/pressure_tubes)Pressure Tubes/$; note that any air-using machines do $(italic)not/$ form part of the network.$(p)You can select a channel via the module GUI, or by right-clicking with any $(item)dye/$; only Logistics Modules of the same color will communicate with each other, effectively giving you 16 $(thing)channels/$ on each network.
一个物流管道模块网络，由所有通过$(l:tubes/pressure_tubes)压力管道/$相互连接的模块组成；请注意，任何使用空气的机器都$(italic)不/$属于该网络。$(p)你可以在模块的 GUI 中选择频道，也可以手持任意$(item)染料/$右键选择；只有相同颜色的物流管道模块之间才会相互通信，这实际上让你在每个网络上都拥有 16 个$(thing)频道/$。

Logistics Modules need $(l:base_concepts/pressure)pressure/$; 3 bar is required to let the modules operate. The air used is a multiplication of distance, amount transported and a constant. This means that it requires more air to transport a full stack of items, and also more to transport it a long way. The air is used at the $(italic)receiving/$ Logistics Module, since the air is flowing towards that module.
物流管道模块需要$(l:base_concepts/pressure)压力/$；模块运行需要 3 巴。消耗的空气量由运输距离、运输数量和一个常数相乘得出。这意味着运输一整组物品需要更多空气，运输距离越远也需要更多空气。空气会在$(italic)接收/$物流管道模块处消耗，因为空气正流向该模块。

Indicator lights are fitted to signify the status:$(p)$(li)$(#f00)Red/$: Not enough pressure, apply at least 3 bar.$(li)$(#f80)Orange/$: More than 3 bar, but not enough pressure to transport the items/fluids this distance.$(li)$(#0f0)Green/$: Enough pressure, on standby.$(li)$(#00f)Blue (pulse)/$: Items/fluids are being transported.
装有指示灯以显示状态：$(p)$(li)$(#f00)红色/$：压力不足，至少施加 3 bar 的压力。$(li)$(#f80)橙色/$：压力超过 3 bar，但仍不足以将物品/流体运输这么远的距离。$(li)$(#0f0)绿色/$：压力充足，待机中。$(li)$(#00f)蓝色（脉冲）/$：正在运输物品/流体。
